edges.act_citation_note:
THE INSTRUMENT WAS NOT READ HERE AND IS BELIEVED TO EXIST. Its title and date
come from two documents that were read at the bytes: Summorum Pontificum names
it `Quattuor Abhinc Annos` beside Ecclesia Dei, and this repository's passage
record for Ecclesia Dei states that the motu proprio's footnote `identifies the
letter Quattuor abhinc annos of 3 October 1984` [recorded:
src/sources/works/john-paul-ii/ecclesia-dei/editions/english-vatican-web-2026-07-25/passages/complete-text.toml].

So the act is named, dated and twice attested by later instruments, and its own
text has not been read. `not-found` is exactly that state, and it is not
`none-claimed`: an instrument is claimed here and is missing, which is a
different thing from a printing for which no instrument is claimed at all.
edges.act_citation_scope:
ADDED 2026-08-01, and THE SEARCH IT RECORDS FOUND SOMETHING. This is section
7.2's correction happening a second time, caught this time by the rule that
correction produced.

Searched: THIS REPOSITORY'S OWN SOURCE LIBRARY, for `quattuor abhinc annos`,
case-insensitively. Four files answer. Two are inventories, one is the Ecclesia
Dei passage record this note already cites -- and the fourth is
src/sources/works/holy-see/acta-apostolicae-sedis/editions/volume-76-1984/edition.toml,
whose own notes read that the complete 1984 volume `carries the Congregation for
Divine Worship's letter of 3 October 1984 on the use of the Roman Missal of 1962
(Quattuor abhinc annos) at pp. 1088-1089`. That edition has a registered OCR PDF
artifact beneath it.

SO THE INSTRUMENT IS AT NAMED PAGES OF A VOLUME THIS REPOSITORY ALREADY HOLDS,
and `not-found` here means not in the missal corpus this slice reads. The value
is left as it stands because promoting it is a claim that somebody READ the
letter, and nobody has; naming a document and reading it are different acts. The
next lane to touch this station should open pages 1088-1089 of that artifact,
and the station should then become `cited-in-corpus`.
edges.parent_basis:
A FORK, not a merge: one parent, on another line, which is how a line is born.
The edge is drawn because Summorum Pontificum, read here at the bytes, names
this letter and Ecclesia Dei as `the previous documents` laying down `the
conditions for the use of THIS MISSAL` -- the Missal `promulgated by Blessed
John XXIII in 1962`. The act's subject is the 1962 typical edition, so the edge
runs from that station.
